description: This file defines the 'flow' package for managing interactive steps, buttons, dialogs, and attachments in a Mattermost plugin, including rendering logic and context parsing.

classes.name: Step
classes.description: Represents a step in a flow, including message attachments, buttons, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: Represents an interactive button with optional dialog and click handlers.

methods.name: NewStep
methods.description: Creates a new Step instance with a given name.

methods.name: WithButton
methods.description: Adds buttons to a Step.

methods.name: Terminal
methods.description: Marks a Step as terminal, preventing further actions.

methods.name: OnRender
methods.description: Sets a custom render function for a Step.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Sets the next step to forward to and enables auto-forward.

methods.name: WithImage
methods.description: Sets an image URL for the message attachment, parsing relative URLs.

methods.name: WithColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the message attachment.

methods.name: WithPretext
methods.description: Sets pretext for the message attachment.

methods.name: WithField
methods.description: Adds a field to the message attachment.

methods.name: WithTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the message attachment.

methods.name: WithText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the message attachment.

methods.name: do
methods.description: Executes the onRender function and renders the Step.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Renders the Step as completed, disabling buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the message post with attachments and buttons.

methods.name: processAttachment
methods.description: Processes and formats a message attachment based on current flow state.

methods.name: processButtons
methods.description: Formats button labels based on current state.

methods.name: processDialog
methods.description: Formats dialog elements based on current state.

methods.name: renderButton
methods.description: Creates a post action for a button.

methods.name: buttonContext
methods.description: Extracts step name and button index from a button click request.

methods.name: dialogContext
methods.description: Extracts step name and button index from a dialog submission request.
